This pull request adds a Minecraft Bedrock add-on with three lucky-block tiers, a registry of events, player progression, pack assets, and operator settings. It also adds build, packaging, validation, test, and audit tools, plus documentation and evidence records. The records state that device-dependent verification remains incomplete.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~60 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Player participant Main as main.js participant Selector as selectEvent participant Registry as EVENTS participant Operations as EventOperations Player->>Main: Break a supported lucky block Main->>Selector: Select from the tier weights Selector->>Registry: Read eligible event records Selector-->>Main: Return selected event Main->>Operations: Run the event handler Operations-->>Player: Apply event outcome ```

Apply the same shape to the collection message’s `with` value, ensuring each rawtext element is a `RawMessage` object rather than a bare string. Preserve the existing English fallback guidance. Update the purchase flow in showSkills while preserving its existing save and confirmation behavior. - Line 73: Update the message arguments in the opening notification and collection body so every `with` value conforms to `string[] | RawMessage`. Derive each status from current test evidence or preserve the separately maintained status, keeping existing status values intact when no new evidence is available.
